newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends firm after fuel importers' order.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends firm after fuel importers' order.

text.p: A modest rise in dollar demand slowed down the Bulgarian lev's advance to 224-225 per dollar at the close from 225.00/80 in the morning after calm interbank forex trade, dealers said.
"Foreign currency supply outweighed demand due to the current high yield on lev-denominated investments, and the lev was headed to strengthen beyond 224," a bank dealer said.
But trade consolidated in a 224-225 levs per dollar range in mid-afternoon after a large fuel importer appeared in the market bidding for dollars at 224.20/50 levs.

Banks and final clients have been shortening forex positions in favour of lev-denominated investments since last week due to their high yield under the current record high main interest rate of 25 percent monthly, or 300 percent annually.
The lev traded at 236-237 per dollar a week ago before the rate rise. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
